pl.summary: Cel: cienki worek lekko wypchany słomą, arkusz tektury lub płótno naciągnięte na ramę. Assegaje wykonuje się z prętów, z obciążonymi końcami zaostrzonymi lub z żelaznymi grotami strzał na nich.

en.title: Throwing the Assegai
en.summary: Target, a thin sack, lightly stuffed with straw, or a sheet of cardboard, or canvas stretched on a frame. Assegais to be made of wands, with weighted ends sharpened, or with iron arrow-heads on them.

en.summary: On a limited, enclosed space, one is to catch a Scout who, every minute, either whistles once or lights a match for a duration of 5 seconds. The pursuit is thus guided by both sight and hearing. If the pursuer does not catch the runner within the designated…

en.summary: Each competitor is given a long straight stick in daytime, and told to lay it due north and south. In doing this he may guide himself by sun, moss, or anything he can find in nature--anything, indeed, except a compass. The direction is checked by a good…
